evidence.title: Formal verification expands reported coverage while retaining specification dependencies
evidence.observation: Source-reported finding: The authors report proofs covering 239 entry points in 123 libraries, and reduced token use through proof reuse in a shared-workspace experiment. The public repository lists a released subset of 61 entry points in 26 libraries. Observation period and measurement context: A few weeks before publication; exact run dates not established.
evidence.evidence_standing: Source-reported bounded account; study or measurement; not independently reproduced
evidence.glossary_fit: Illustrative or qualifying; does not validate a definition

source_locations.SRC-126: Methods and limitations; six-page appendix; proof-repository README

evidence.limitations: Guarantees depend on specifications, machine and OS models, the checker, and bounded inputs and execution assumptions. Formally verified does not mean bug-free or deployment-wide secure. Proofs were not executed by the Commons.
evidence.open_questions: Transfer to other populations, tasks and operating environments remains unestablished. Missing measurement details are not inferred.
evidence.support_assessment: Commons interpretation: Capability expansion can shift assurance dependencies. Designed proof sharing is not unauthorized autonomous coordination.
evidence.dispute_status: See source version and dispute qualifications; no systematic clearance claimed.
evidence.verification_status: Not independently verified by the Commons

terms.name: Assurance
terms.definition: Evidence-supported confidence that specified properties or outcomes will hold under stated objectives, operating conditions, and assumptions. Assurance has a defined scope and can lose relevance when those conditions change.

terms.name: Constraint compression
terms.definition: A reduction, often AI-enabled, in the practical barriers of knowledge, expertise, labor, cost, time, or coordination that once limited an activity. It describes the change in constraints, not the eventual impact of the activity.

relationships.explanation: Illustrates a reported reduction in effort barriers within specified verification tasks.
Highlights specification, checker and environmental assumptions bounding assurance.
